breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously. It resolved the ambiguity by selecting the RAS model (as indicated by `simulationType RAS;`) and explicitly instructed to not include the LES block in the `turbulenceProperties` file, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
